# GOV.UK Frontend (vendored)

- Source: `govuk-frontend` 5.14.0 from npm (https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-frontend)
- Licence: MIT, © Crown copyright. Licence text: https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-frontend/blob/main/LICENSE.txt
- Modification: the GDS Transport typeface and its `@font-face` rules have been
  removed from `govuk-frontend.min.css` and replaced with Arial. GDS Transport is
  licensed only for services on the GOV.UK domain, so PHAEMA must not use it.
- PHAEMA does not use the GOV.UK crown logo or GOV.UK branding.
